leads.name: Blue Dahlia
leads.contact_source: Buro 247 Nyonya 糕点清单（2025-03 更新）写明 WhatsApp；Malay Mail 2025-04 也列同一号码
leads.why: PJ Section 17 的马六甲娘惹糕店，每天 18–20 种糕点和黄梨挞；Malay Mail、FMT 都报道过，只靠 IG 和 WhatsApp 接单。
leads.verify: 看 IG 有没有接节日 / 派对大订单；黄梨挞一罐卖多少钱。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Melaka Peranakan kuih café, 601 Jalan 17/12, Section 17, Petaling Jaya. 18–20 kuih made fresh daily (bingka ubi, talam, ketayap, pulut panggang), pineapple tarts, butter cakes, Nyonya laksa, cendol.
Signals: Malay Mail review (Apr 2025); FMT feature (Feb 2026) on the Peranakan duo Yugin Lee and Nina Yeoh; Buro 247 kuih list (updated Mar 2025); LifestyleAsia Raya kuih list (Feb 2026).
Budget signal: Physical café plus repeated media coverage (no price list published).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh bluedahlia → PARKED (not theirs); bluedahliamy, bluedahliapj → NONE. (b) Searched 'Blue Dahlia Petaling Jaya kuih order online website': no own site or web shop; Buro lists WhatsApp and Instagram only. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: WhatsApp 011-2980 3362 (Buro 247, Malay Mail).
Observation: FMT (Feb 2026) 'At Blue Dahlia, serving tasty treats is a piece of kuih': 18 to 20 varieties made fresh every day.
Angle: Kuih platters / party boxes and festive pineapple tart pre-orders with pick-up slots; corporate tea orders.
Sources: https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/leisure/2026/02/05/at-blue-dahlia-serving-tasty-treats-is-a-piece-of-kuih ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2025/04/05/for-outstanding-melaka-peranakan-kuih-cakes-and-desserts-head-over-to-blue-dahlia-in-section-17-pj/171953 ; https://www.buro247.my/lifestyle/food-drink/10-best-places-to-order-your-favourite-malay-and-nyonya-kuih-in-the-klang-valley.html

leads.name: Baba Beng
leads.contact_source: Buro 247 Nyonya 糕点清单（2025-03 更新）写明 WhatsApp
leads.why: PJ Section 4 的娘惹糕点和娘惹咖椰，Buro 247 2025 年推荐；现在靠 WhatsApp、Facebook 接单。
leads.verify: 确认 WhatsApp 号码（有的报道写 012-238 1396，可能是别家）；看 Shopee 还有没有在卖咖椰。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Nyonya kuih and Nyonya kaya, 14 Lorong Assunta A, Section 4, Petaling Jaya. Kuih kochi, pulut tekan, kuih lapis, ketayap; kaya jars.
Signals: Buro 247 kuih list (updated Mar 2025); Malay Mail delivery feature (May 2020); TheSmartLocal Nyonya kuih list.
Budget signal: Physical shop plus media coverage; kaya also sold on Shopee/Lazada (Malay Mail 2020).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh mybababeng, bababeng → NONE. (b) Searched 'Baba Beng Petaling Jaya Nyonya kaya order online': orders via WhatsApp / Facebook; marketplaces only, no own web shop. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: WhatsApp 012-288 7449 (Buro 247, Mar 2025).
Observation: Buro 247 lists Nyonya kaya, kuih kochi, pulut tekan, kuih lapis, ordered via Facebook / WhatsApp.
Angle: Own shop for kaya jars (ship nationwide) plus kuih set pre-orders; festive gift boxes.
Sources: https://www.buro247.my/lifestyle/food-drink/10-best-places-to-order-your-favourite-malay-and-nyonya-kuih-in-the-klang-valley.html ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2020/05/04/mco-food-delivery-savour-baba-bengs-nyonya-kuih-for-that-perfect-teatime-tr/1862812

leads.name: Secawan Tepung
leads.contact_source: Buro 247 糕点清单（2025-03 更新）写明 WhatsApp
leads.why: 22 种 kuih talam 加外烩，100 粒 RM85–90；SAYS 2024、Buro 2025 都推荐，只靠 IG 和 WhatsApp 接单。
leads.verify: 看 IG 最近还有在接单；开场白可以用马来文或英文（看他们 IG 用什么语言）。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Kuih maker with pick-up in South Bangsar, KL; 22 types of kuih talam, kuih lapis, angku, bingka ubi; butter cakes, cheesecakes, brownies, Raya cookies; catering.
Signals: SAYS kuih list (Mar 2024); Buro 247 kuih list (updated Mar 2025).
Budget signal: RM85–90 for 100 pieces of kuih (SAYS 2024); catering service.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh secawantepung → NONE. (b) Searched 'Secawan Tepung kuih order website': only Instagram / WhatsApp; delivery via Grab or Lalamove arranged by them. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: WhatsApp 011-1165 5688 (Buro 247).
Observation: SAYS (Mar 2024) 'boasts a long list of delicious treats, including 22 different types of kuih talam', plus catering.
Angle: Order form for 100-piece trays / event catering with date and quantity; Raya cookie pre-orders.
Sources: https://says.com/my/makan/where-to-buy-kuih-muih ; https://www.buro247.my/lifestyle/food-drink/10-best-places-to-order-your-favourite-malay-and-nyonya-kuih-in-the-klang-valley.html

leads.name: Hideaway Café
leads.contact_source: Malaysia Food and Travel 报道（2025-08，经 Newswav 转载）写的联络电话
leads.why: PJ Happy Mansion 开了约 7 年的娘惹 auntie 牛油蛋糕咖啡馆，2025 年 8 月有报道，没有网站。
leads.verify: 这个号码是报道里的电话，发 WhatsApp 前先看能不能用；看 IG 有没有接整个蛋糕预订。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Family-run café, AG7 Block A, Happy Mansion, Section 17, Petaling Jaya. Owner Doreen Thean (Nyonya, former flight attendant) bakes butter cakes daily: lemon drizzle, pandan gula Melaka, banana pecan raisin loaf.
Signals: About seven years open; Malaysia Food and Travel feature (Aug 2025, via Newswav); Tatler Happy Mansion guide; Eat Drink KL.
Budget signal: Physical café plus coverage (no whole-cake prices published).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh hideaway17, hideawaycafe, hideawaypj → NONE. (b) Searched 'Hideaway Cafe Section 17' order / website: no web shop found. (c) No other brand.
Contacts: 013-757 1237 (Malaysia Food and Travel, Aug 2025).
Observation: Aug 2025 article: 'butter cakes made with Nyonya motherly love', about ten cakes on any given day, baked by Doreen herself.
Angle: Whole butter cake / loaf pre-orders and gift boxes (festive, corporate); simple menu + pick-up site.
Sources: https://newswav.com/article/if-you-love-butter-cakes-made-with-nyonya-motherly-love-happy-mansion-s-hid-A2508_dQGCes ; https://www.tatlerasia.com/dining/food/where-what-to-eat-happy-mansion-in-section-17-pj

leads.name: Contour
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 新年糕点清单（2026-02）写的电话
leads.why: PJ Old Town 的烘豆店 + 烘焙咖啡馆，老板是 Malaysia Barista Champion，2025 年扩店一倍；咖啡豆只在 Shopee 卖，没有自己的网站。
leads.verify: 这个号码在 TheSmartLocal 写成电话，发 WhatsApp 前先确认；看 Shopee 店还有没有在用。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Coffee roastery and bakery-café, 55 Jalan 1/12, PJ Old Town, Petaling Jaya. Founder Jason Loo (multi-time Malaysia Barista Champion). Croissants, danishes, seasonal pastries; roasted beans.
Signals: Malay Mail launch feature (Oct 2023); TheSmartLocal on their expansion next door (2025); TheSmartLocal CNY pastry list (Feb 2026); Time Out.
Budget signal: Physical café that doubled its space (TheSmartLocal) plus coverage; sells own roasted beans.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh contourpj, contourcoffee, contourroastery, contourcoffeepj → NONE; contour.com / contour.com.my are other companies. (b) Searched 'Contour coffee roastery PJ beans online shop': Time Out says beans are sold in-store or on Shopee; no own site. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: 011-1673 5503 (TheSmartLocal, Feb 2026).
Observation: TheSmartLocal (Feb 2026): Walnut Black Sesame Danish for CNY, orders by phone.
Angle: Own bean shop with subscriptions (higher margin than Shopee), pastry box pre-orders, wholesale beans for offices/cafés.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/chinese-new-year-pastries/ ; https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2023/10/12/three-time-malaysia-barista-champion-jason-loo-launches-contour-his-first-coffee-roastery-and-bakery-in-pj-old-town/95755 ; https://thesmartlocal.my/contour-pj/ ; https://www.timeout.com/kuala-lumpur/restaurants/contour

leads.name: Le Petit Four Pâtisserie
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 槟城烘焙店清单（2023-09 更新）和圣诞蛋糕清单写的订购电话
leads.why: 槟城 Lebuh Pantai 的法式甜点店（2018 年开，Le Cordon Bleu 出身的老板），Vulcan Post 2024 报道；以前的网站已经过期。
leads.verify: 看 IG 简介是不是还放着过期的网站；问节日蛋糕 / 整个蛋糕是不是只能打电话订。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: French patisserie-café, 310 Lebuh Pantai, George Town, Penang. Chef-owner Ooi Hooi Shing (ex-Intel engineer, Le Cordon Bleu Paris, staged at Shangri-La Paris), co-founder Elveen Tai. Croissants, tarts, entremets, festive cakes.
Signals: Opened 2018; Vulcan Post profile (2024) calls it one of Penang's most popular café-bakeries; TheSmartLocal Penang bakeries; So Good magazine feature on the chef.
Budget signal: Physical shop plus coverage; tarts RM16–22 each, Christmas cakes by order.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh lepetitfourpatisserie → lepetitfourpatisserie.com EXPIRED (title only, no content); lepetitfour.com shows a Wix 'ConnectYourDomain Error'. (b) Searched 'Le Petit Four Patisserie Penang order online website': ordering by phone only. (c) No other brand.
Contacts: 016-409 3918 (TheSmartLocal; Christmas roundup).
Observation: Vulcan Post (2024): 'a stalwart in the Penang patisserie scene for six years'; chef says no big expansion plans, focus on quality.
Angle: Pre-order site for whole cakes and festive bakes (pick-up date, deposit); the old domain is expired so customers who search hit a dead page.
Sources: https://vulcanpost.com/876184/le-petit-four-patisserie-french-pastry-desserts-penang-malaysia ; https://thesmartlocal.my/bakeries-in-penang/ ; https://gempak.com/rojakdaily/lifestyle/sugar-rush-9-places-get-your-christmas-cake-and-sweet-treats-penang-68939

leads.name: Ome by Spacebar Coffee
leads.contact_source: Newswav 转载的报道（2025-04）写的联络电话；2020 年 TheSmartLocal 写 019-309 1450
leads.why: 槟城巷子里的咖啡馆，2025 年入选 World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 第 56 名；店里卖咖啡豆（RM30/150g），没有网上商店。
leads.verify: 两个号码不一样（019-690 8259 / 019-309 1450），发之前看 IG 简介哪个是现在用的。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Specialty coffee bar, 1 Lorong Toh Aka, George Town, Penang. Founders Joachim Leong and Shean Tan (ex-baristas; started as a KL pop-up). Sells beans (house blend RM30/150g, single origins RM35/100g in 2020), cakes, chocolate bars.
Signals: No. 56 on the inaugural World's 100 Best Coffee Shops 2025 (Vulcan Post, Time Out Asia, Feb–Apr 2025); Malay Mail since 2015/2017.
Budget signal: Physical café plus international recognition; retail beans.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh omebyspacebar → NONE; spacebarcoffee.com is a Hostinger parked page. (b) Searched 'Ome Spacebar coffee Penang beans order online website': beans sold in the café only, no web shop. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: 019-690 8259 (newer article, 2025) / 019-309 1450 (TheSmartLocal 2020).
Observation: Vulcan Post (2025): one of three Malaysian cafés on the World's 100 Best Coffee Shops list.
Angle: Bean shop + subscription for fans outside Penang (the ranking brings visitors who want to reorder at home); gift sets.
Sources: https://vulcanpost.com/881899/malaysian-cafe-the-worlds-100-best-coffee-shops-2025 ; https://newswav.com/article/this-penang-cafe-s-hidden-in-an-alley-but-is-still-listed-among-the-world-s-A2504_ex2oRT ; https://thesmartlocal.my/penang-cafes/amp/

leads.name: Whisk
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 槟城烘焙店清单（2023-09 更新）写的电话
leads.why: 槟城 Queen Street 的蛋糕店，接整个蛋糕和定制蛋糕（6 寸 RM89）；B 级：最新的报道是 2023 年。
leads.verify: 看 IG 最近还有发文；这个号码报道写成电话，发 WhatsApp 前确认。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Cake shop-café, 15 Queen Street, George Town, Penang. Slice cakes, macarons; whole cakes on pre-order and customised cakes.
Signals: TheSmartLocal Penang bakeries list (last updated Sep 2023). Missing: coverage in the last 2 years (B).
Budget signal: 4-inch Mango Naked Cake RM69, 6-inch Mix Fruits Cake RM89 (TheSmartLocal).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh whiskmy, whiskpenang → NONE. (b) Searched 'Whisk Queen Street Penang cakes order online website': no own site; Facebook/Instagram and phone only. (c) No other brand.
Contacts: 016-226 0715 (TheSmartLocal).
Observation: TheSmartLocal: 'offers whole cakes upon preorders and customized cakes as well'.
Angle: Whole-cake pre-order page (size, flavour, date), birthday cake gallery.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/bakeries-in-penang/ ; https://tablejourney.com/malaysia/penang/bakeries/whisk/

leads.name: Dreamz Bakery
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal PJ 甜点咖啡馆清单（2023-02）写的电话
leads.why: Kota Damansara 开了 10 年以上的蛋糕咖啡馆（棋盘蛋糕），一片 RM17–22；B 级：最新报道是 2023 年。
leads.verify: 看 IG 最近还有发文、有没有接整个蛋糕；2017 年报道提过网站，现在打不开。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Cake café, 32-1 The Strand, Kota Damansara, Petaling Jaya. Around 18 cakes incl. checkerboard cakes, cempedak pandan, durian pandan, jasmine black forest.
Signals: Reviewed since 2013–2017 (Discover KL 2017); TheSmartLocal PJ dessert cafés (Feb 2023); Time Out kids' birthday cakes. Missing: coverage in the last 2 years (B).
Budget signal: Slices RM17–22 (TheSmartLocal 2023); physical café plus coverage.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh dreamzbakery → NONE (a 2017 article mentioned a website; it no longer resolves). (b) Searched 'Dreamz Bakery Kota Damansara cake order online': no web shop found. (c) No other brand.
Contacts: 012-200 3441 (TheSmartLocal, Discover KL).
Observation: TheSmartLocal (2023): Strawberry Shortcake RM22/slice, Strawberry Vanilla Checkerboard Cake.
Angle: Whole cake / birthday cake pre-order site with pick-up times.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/pj-dessert-cafes/ ; https://discoverkl.com/2017/03/29/dreamz-bakery-kota-damansara

leads.name: Le Dux Patisserie
leads.contact_source: TheSmartLocal 槟城烘焙店清单（2023-09 更新）写的电话
leads.why: 槟城 Lebuh Pantai 的法式甜点店（提拉米苏 RM28、塔 RM19–22）；B 级：只找到 2023 年的推荐。
leads.verify: 看 IG 最近还有营业 / 发文；问有没有整个蛋糕或节日订单。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: French patisserie, 255 Lebuh Pantai, George Town, Penang. Classic tiramisu, croissants, pistachio lemon tart, vanilla raspberry tart, mango passion tart.
Signals: TheSmartLocal Penang bakeries (updated Sep 2023). Missing: coverage in the last 2 years (B).
Budget signal: Physical shop plus coverage; tiramisu RM28, tarts RM19–22.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh leduxpatisserie → NONE; ledux.com/.co parked. (b) Searched 'Le Dux Patisserie Penang order online whole cake': nothing found. (c) No other brand.
Contacts: 017-420 8400 (TheSmartLocal).
Observation: TheSmartLocal lists Classic Tiramisu (RM28) and Pistachio Lemon Tart (RM22).
Angle: Pre-order for whole tiramisu / tart boxes and festive orders; Penang delivery slots.
Sources: https://thesmartlocal.my/bakeries-in-penang/
